thesis: Three axis values (count family, interest_niche, clicks) are unpriced; mandate the coverage sweep before any angle preference.
Auto-mode cells unreadable two consecutive batches; suspend auto and reallocate its budget to fixed sales cells.
Clicks is the last unpriced objective; add a standing coverage slot to price unswept axis values before refining.
Interest_niche sales spend converts to purchases at the best per-dollar rate; lean the sales budget toward niche with probe floors elsewhere.
Benefit family holds 3 of 4 lifetime buys and the cheapest matched CPLs; make benefit the default with two variants per batch and probe slots for parked families.
The niche lean failed its confirming experiment (two $70 niche eras, zero buys); equalize the three sales cells.
Leads has zero lifetime purchases on $245 while pv-broad holds the best per-dollar record; shift traffic budget to pageviews, leads to a $15 probe.
At ~1 buy per $400, single-batch purchase counts are below readability; require two-batch windows for goal-layer allocation changes and freeze budget shape within windows.
